items.headline: Tiger Woods 2026 Majors
items.text: Tiger Woods is not expected to play any of the 2026 majors, raising questions about the future of his competitive major career.

items.headline: LIV Players Eye Overseas Tours
items.text: LIV Golf players may be increasing starts on global tours like the Japan Tour as LIV's funding and future remain uncertain.
